mapper.select: SELECT hda.duration_attachment_id, hda.hd_id, hda.attachment_category, hda.document_name, hda.description, (SELECT wm_concat(fat.file_name) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fat, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam WHERE fat.attachment_id = faam.attachment_id AND faam.table_name = 'HLS_DURATION_ATTACHMENT' AND faam.table_pk_value = hda.duration_attachment_id) file_name, (select wm_concat(faa.attachment_id) from fnd_atm_attachment faa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam where faam.table_name = 'HLS_DURATION_ATTACHMENT' and faam.table_pk_value = hda.duration_attachment_id and faa.source_pk_value = faam.record_id) attachment_id_n, (select wm_concat(faa.source_pk_value) from fnd_atm_attachment faa,fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam where faam.table_name = 'HLS_DURATION_ATTACHMENT' and faam.table_pk_value = hda.duration_attachment_id and faa.source_pk_value = faam.record_id) source_pk_value, hda.last_update_date upload_date, (SELECT su.description FROM sys_user su WHERE su.user_id = hda.created_by) upload_person, hda.created_by upload_person_id FROM hls_duration_attachment hda WHERE hda.attachment_category = #{attachmentCategory} AND hda.hd_id = #{hdId}
